summary.text: Laurie Davies is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 74 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her background includes restaurant management, business ownership and local transportation boards.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Davies was born in Wisconsin and lives in Laguna Niguel, California.
She earned a B.A. from California State University, Long Beach, and her career experience includes working as a restaurant manager and owning a business.

Davies served as a board member of the Transportation Corridor Agency, chaired the League of Cities Committee on Transportation, Communication and Public Works, and was elected to the Orange County Transportation Authority.
She also served on the board of the Association of California Cities, Orange County, and as its president.
Davies was re-elected to the Assembly on November 5, 2024, defeating Democrat Chris Duncan, 50.8 percent to 49.2 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary she received 52.3 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat Sergio Farias.

For 2025 and 2026 she was vice chair of the Governmental Organization Committee and the Transportation Committee, and a member of the Military and Veterans Affairs, Utilities and Energy, and Fisheries and Aquaculture committees.
